extra.final_summary: Found and fixed several data issues affecting the average body mass by sex. One exact duplicate row was removed. Island names had leading/trailing spaces (e.g., ' Biscoe') which were normalized. Species names had misspellings ('Gentto', 'Chinstarp') corrected to 'Gentoo' and 'Chinstrap'. Body mass was stored as text with commas; converted to numeric. Two body mass values (3.7M and 3.475M grams) were extreme outliers (likely extra zeros) and excluded as they were far outside the valid 2500-6500g range. One row had missing sex and was excluded by the analysis. The average body mass is 4017.74g for females and 4385.16g for males.
